questions.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
What is the capital of Australia?
questions.note: Sydney is the usual wrong answer.

questions.prompt: Which country has three capital cities?
questions.note: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein — executive, legislative and judicial.

questions.prompt: What is the longest river in Africa?
What is the highest mountain above sea level?
Which mountain range separates Europe from Asia?
Which country's flag has a red maple leaf on it?
How many stars are on the flag of the United States?
Which is the only national flag that is not a rectangle or a square?
questions.note: Switzerland and Vatican City are square, so 'not four-sided' is the point.
